entry.title: oai-math-revised: a community hub for revising OpenAI’s math write-ups
entry.summary:
[This is a guest post by Abhinav Nellore, Johannes Schmitt, Soledad Villar, and Rachel Ward – T.] OpenAI’s math write-ups at https://github.com/openai/math can be difficult to understand and can have incomplete citations. https://github.com/mathcommunity/oai-math-revised/ seeks to be an inclusive effort to improve these write-ups, and the broader math community–students, postdocs, professors, and enthusiasts–is invited to participate. entry.title: Octonions and the Standard Model (Part 15)
entry.summary:
John Baez, Endre Bokor and Latham Boyle have a new paper which gets at the Standard Model gauge group and its representation on one generation of fermions starting from a Jordan triple that consists of pairs of bioctonions.
